classification: DCI-1 PROTOCOL v4 REVISION 3 (ADOPTED, NOT FROZEN)
standing: a verifier audit, not §10.3. The verdict was visible before each assessment, so no figure here is a human-verifier agreement rate and none may be reported as one.
what_a_finding_costs: changing a verifier changes the canonical hash, which every §10.2 artifact, every stage record and all 30,144 stored verdicts are bound to. A confirmed defect is a CHANGES_SCIENTIFIC.md entry, a re-run of §10.2's evidence, and a re-derivation of anything measured under the old hash.
